_meta.note: Candidate reaction rules for the US and China as external counterparties in Orbit Accord (Game B). Proposed game mechanics, NOT calibrated probabilities and NOT observed reactions of either government to a middle-power AI-safety coalition (none exists to observe).
_meta.source_ids: See the source ledger in us-china.md. Statuses there mark primary vs secondary and read vs located.
_meta.evidence_rule: Every rule cites source IDs and carries an explicit limit. Facts and interpretation are separated in us-china.md sections 2-3; only rules are listed here.

dated_events.what: BIS Affiliates Rule suspension ends; >=50%-owned affiliates of Entity List parties re-inherit restrictions unless extended.
dated_events.status_at_cutoff: No extension located in the Federal Register through 2026-11-01 (S10). Unresolved.

dated_events.what: MOFCOM/GAC Announcement No. 70 suspension of the Oct 2025 export-control package (Announcements 55-58, 61, 62) ends.
dated_events.status_at_cutoff: Trade press reports a MOFCOM statement of 2026-09-28 extending the arrangement to 2027-01-10, but no amending notice was published as of 2026-10-27; a 2026-10-11 report said no extension was confirmed. Primary not located. Unresolved.

dated_events.what: Next exchange of the US-China Super Intelligence (SI) Dialogue due 'by November 2026' per the joint state-visit fact sheet; a bilateral SI incident channel was agreed 2026-09-25.

candidate_rules.replaces: game.js:93 penalty on condition 1 (mandatory form only)
candidate_rules.objective: Keep model release free of foreign mandatory approval while obtaining early access voluntarily.
candidate_rules.authority_instrument: June 2026 EO: express clause against mandatory model licensing/pre-clearance/permitting; voluntary early-access framework with developers (S4); AI Action Plan deregulation pillar (S1).
candidate_rules.trigger: Coalition demands safety-institute testing as a licensing condition for hosted/served models.
candidate_rules.plausible_response: Rejection letter citing the no-mandatory-preclearance policy, plus a counteroffer (voluntary access for cyber-defence tooling).
candidate_rules.substitute: Membership of the AI-cybersecurity clearinghouse and NIST/CAISI agentic-AI standards initiative (S3, S4).
candidate_rules.limits: No documented US response to a middle-power coalition demand exists; the EO is domestic policy. Extrapolates a stated domestic principle.

candidate_rules.replaces: game.js:93 penalty on condition 5 (remove; currently unsupported)
candidate_rules.objective: Visibility of where advanced chips are; enforcement against diversion.
candidate_rules.authority_instrument: Affiliates Rule diversion rationale (S6); Entity List enforcement; scheduled snapback 2026-11-10 (S7).
candidate_rules.trigger: Coalition export licences carry chip-location reporting conditions.

conflicting_scheme_restricting_us_lawful: ask for mutual recognition of compliance

candidate_rules.time_cost: Up to 2 months alignment review; scheduled around the 2026-11-10 snapback date.
candidate_rules.plausible_response: Support when compatible; friction only if the scheme duplicates or restricts lawful US trade.
candidate_rules.substitute: Joint end-use checking instead of parallel national schemes.
candidate_rules.limits: US instruments target diversion to China; a middle-power scheme aimed at all suppliers including US ones has no observed precedent.

candidate_rules.replaces: game.js:165-172 'leans on ally until it leaves' event (reframe as offer, not coercion)
candidate_rules.objective: Partners on the American stack rather than in rule-writing blocs.
candidate_rules.authority_instrument: American AI Exports Program; National Champions Initiative; U.S. Tech Prosperity Corps; Ex-Im/DFC financing (S2, S3); tariff relief for trade-and-security-framework partners (S10); US-Korea Technology Prosperity Deal precedent (S18, located not read).
candidate_rules.trigger: A coalition member is close to joining the player's accord.

member_prioritises_capital_and_market: takes US bilateral package instead of the accord
player_offer_competitive: stays; player can counter next month

candidate_rules.plausible_response: A customised full-stack offer with financing, conditional on standards alignment and anti-diversion compliance; the member chooses.
candidate_rules.substitute: None needed; the game's existing needs() token pricing already models what the member wants.
candidate_rules.limits: Instruments documented; using them to compete with a safety coalition is extrapolation. No coercion mechanism is documented in 2025-26.

candidate_rules.adds: Calendar event in the opening month, independent of player action
candidate_rules.objective: Reimpose affiliates-based Entity List coverage absent an extension.

lapses: coalition members hosting/serving China-linked supply chains face Entity-List-affiliate compliance risk

candidate_rules.plausible_response: Shown on the game board as a dated uncertainty; player stockpile/licence moves interact with it.
candidate_rules.limits: The snapback is current law; whether it was extended before 2026-11-10 is unknown from this pass. The game must not pre-decide it.

candidate_rules.replaces: game.js:124-127 flat retaliation roll vs the licensing country
candidate_rules.objective: Oppose US-aligned export controls targeting China; be seen defending openness.
candidate_rules.authority_instrument: Rare-earth/magnet licensing (slow, case-by-case); entity-specific designation precedent (Announcement No. 30, 2026-07-24, named German/French/Dutch firms) (S12-S15).
candidate_rules.trigger: Player licenses a chokepoint stage with conditions excluding Chinese end users.

first_response: letter of objection citing bloc behaviour
persist: licence backlog for the player's strategic industries: -1 token/month for N months
possible visible designation of one defence-linked national champion

candidate_rules.plausible_response: Slow licensing and targeted designation, not instant embargo; reversible by removing exclusion language or offering reciprocal access.
candidate_rules.substitute: Offer China a role in the accord's standards/incident work (see CN-2) to avoid the trigger entirely.
candidate_rules.limits: Backlog effects on middle powers specifically are inferred from global 2025 effects and European designations; Announcement No. 30 primary not retrieved (cited via S14).

candidate_rules.objective: Inclusive, UN-routed AI governance; reciprocity; capacity building for the Global South.
candidate_rules.authority_instrument: Global AI Governance Action Plan points 10-12 (risk testing/evaluation, incident information sharing and emergency response, mutual-recognition safety-assessment platforms) (S5); A/RES/78/311 (S17); bilateral SI incident channel (S9).
candidate_rules.trigger: Framing of the accord, not its safety content.

un_routed_open_reciprocal: may join condition 2 via extending SI-incident-channel practice

candidate_rules.plausible_response: Acceptance stays hard-won (China's own processes are slow and case-by-case) but is not categorically anti-safety.
candidate_rules.substitute: Coalition can route work through UN mechanisms both powers endorse (Global Dialogue on AI Governance; Independent International Scientific Panel).
candidate_rules.limits: China's positions are stated policy plus one bilateral channel with the US; its reaction to middle-power safety conditions is unobserved.

candidate_rules.adds: Modifier on the game's 'seed your own programme' move
candidate_rules.objective: Jurisdiction over foreign-made goods produced with Chinese rare-earth technology.
candidate_rules.authority_instrument: Oct 2025 package technology trigger (S13, S14; primary via CSET translation, not read).
candidate_rules.trigger: Player builds domestic refining/magnet capacity using Chinese technology.

chinese_technology: new capacity keeps a technology-provenance dependency: exports still exposed to CN licensing if truce lapses
non_chinese_technology: dependency avoided; higher build cost and time

candidate_rules.time_cost: Affects the replicate-years clock rather than the month.
candidate_rules.plausible_response: Licensing exposure on future exports, not an immediate event.
candidate_rules.substitute: Pay more for non-Chinese kit (models the documented choice).
candidate_rules.limits: Technology trigger described in legal analyses of the suspended Oct 2025 package; enforcement never observed (suspended before applying).

unsupported_current_mechanics.mechanic: Unconditional turn-1 (Dec 2026) China metals squeeze when CN not in coalition
unsupported_current_mechanics.verdict: Contradicted at the margin: expansive controls suspended under the truce; general licences issued; Sept 2026 shows shipments still being worked (S8, S9, S12). A squeeze is contingent on the 2026-11-10 lapse (unresolved at cutoff).

unsupported_current_mechanics.mechanic: US 'leans on' weakest ally until it leaves the accord
unsupported_current_mechanics.verdict: Unsupported in form. Documented US instruments are incentive-based (export packages, financing, market access). Reframed in US-3-COMPETING-PACKAGE.

Contradicted: a US-China SI Dialogue plus a bilateral SI incident channel has existed since 2026-09-25 (S9), and both powers support UN AI mechanisms (S5, S17). Flagged for the owner; shared file not edited.
